user.title: Set up Task Points System
user.description: Sets up the task and points management. No further information is required.

init.title: Included users & rewards system
init.description: Choose which Home Assistant users should be considered by this integration. Only selected users get their own points sensor and can be chosen as responsible person when creating/editing tasks. This lets you hide technical users/integration accounts, for example. You can also enable the optional rewards system (points account + redeemable rewards) here.
